evidence.MCL: Mild edema deep to the medial collateral ligament suggesting reactive changes. There is some mass effect on the superficial medial collateral ligament by the extruded medial meniscus.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: moderate grade partial radial tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Longitudinal horizontal tear within the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
evidence.Lateral OA: Mild diffuse chondral thinning. Heterogenous signal intensity of the cartilage in keeping with mild chondropathy.
evidence.PF OA: Mild chondropathy at the medial and patellofemoral compartments.
evidence.Contusion: reactive bone marrow signal edema in keeping with moderate osteoarthritis
evidence.Fracture: raising suspicion for sequelae of a subchondral insufficiency fracture.
